plain: A very small amount, especially of money

webster.text: An allowance of meat in a monastery.

more.text: A very small portion allowed or assigned.

example.quote: The whole proportion of this state of the public debts, except this mere pittance, must be raised from the people by direct and immediate taxation.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. DAVIE, July 31, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
